(Peter Christos/Facebook) (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/09/opinion-i-worked-for-tpusa-glenbrook-norths-tpusa-denial-isnt-just-wrong-its-un-american.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06f395c55c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)
By Peter Christos, Guest Contributor

For far too long, Conservative students on High School and College campuses across the country have faced unfair treatment, being targeted by school administrations, victims of doxxing and even violent attacks, all simply for sharing their ideas and engaging in free speech debate.

Just last week, we witnessed this heartbreaking reality when TPUSA Founder Charlie Kirk was tragically assassinated while speaking in front of thousands of students at Utah Valley University. As conservatives around the country mourned, prayed, and held vigils for Charlie, many on the left celebrated — a stark reminder of the deep divisions in our country.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/09/opinion-i-worked-for-tpusa-glenbrook-norths-tpusa-denial-isnt-just-wrong-its-un-american.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=06f395c55c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
Attendees waiting for the vigil to begin. (Source: Sean Miles)
At Glenbrook North, we see the struggle for students who are Pro-America and Pro-Free Speech. Last year, a large group of GBN Students attempted to start a Turning Point USA High School Chapter on campus. After meeting with the administration, they denied TPUSA students the right to start a Pro-America Club on campus.

The reason given? That the school “already has a club like that.”

But this simply isn’t true.

A look at Glenbrook North’s official Clubs and Organizations list reveals no club shares the core values of Turning Point USA which include: promoting free speech and open dialogue; advocating for limited government; supporting free-market capitalism; celebrating American values and the Constitution, among many other things.

The reality is clear: TPUSA was denied because it is considered a ‘Conservative’ organization.

I speak from personal experience when I say Glenbrook North has shown bias, unfair treatment, and even allowed violence against Conservative students. Years later, nothing has changed to make the school a more inclusive place where all students feel welcome.

Every student regardless of political beliefs, deserves to express their thoughts freely and safely. The Equal Access Act makes it clear that if one club is allowed, all others must be given equal access, regardless of political or ideological views.

While Glenbrook North embraces ultra-liberal and Progressive clubs like Students Demand Action and GSA, it refuses to allow TPUSA (a 501(c)(3) non-profit) on campus. It is a shameful double standard for a school that prides itself on inclusivity to silence half its students.

This is a clear violation of free speech and un-American.

Following the tragic assassination of TPUSA Founder Charlie Kirk, numerous Glenbrook North students who personally knew him reached out to me to organize what we expected to be a small vigil in downtown Northbrook.

What happened was the opposite.

It was confirmed that over 1,500 people from our community showed up, 150 of them current Glenbrook North students, to honor the life and legacy of Charlie. So many members of the community showed up to pay their respects to Charlie, we had to move locations to accommodate the crowd.

Students and community members from all political backgrounds came together to mourn and pray with us, because TPUSA and Charlie Kirk stood for freedom of debate and expression and didn’t deny or reject you based on your political beliefs. It was a somber, but unforgettable evening of unity and love, regardless of your political beliefs. This is something our country needs more of.

The outpouring of support towards current TPUSA students at GBN from the Northbrook community has been inspiring. With the new school year starting, and in the wake of Charlie Kirk’s assassination, I urge Glenbrook North to reconsider its decision and allow Turning Point USA to exist on campus.

We have no room left for division, bias, or political violence, at every level in this country. It must all be condemned and stopped. It’s time to come together, listen to every voice, and ensure every student has a seat at the table.

This is our Turning Point America.

Illinois Review is the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source in Illinois that has been shared by President Donald Trump. Twitter () Facebook () IllinoisReview.com () Buffalo Grove Teacher Seen Packing Up Classroom After Outrage Over Social Media Posts on Kirk Killing () Carolyn Pinta, left, attends a meeting in Buffalo Grove in 2019. (John J. Kim/Chicago Tribune) By Illinois Review A Buffalo Grove middle school teacher who drew criticism for online comments about the assassination of conservative activist Charlie Kirk has been seen clearing out her classroom amid mounting backlash. Chicagoland radio host Amy Jacobson broke the news on X: “She’s packing up! Hearing from multiple sources that Carolyn Pinta is packing up and leaving the school.” Jacobson noted, “We don’t know if she was fired or resigned.” The middle school teacher has generated national attention on social media – even drawing the attention of former New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani – after posting comments on Facebook about the assassination of conservative activist Charlie Kirk — calling his death “ironic” after a friend remarked that “karma is a bch.” “Mel Smith, listen — the irony is thick, right?” commented Carolyn Pinta. The middle school teacher went on to write that the now deceased Kirk “believed in sacrificing a few souls each year to keep his Second Amendment rights.” In an earlier comment on the same thread, Pinta compared Kirk’s events to early Nazi rallies after another friend remarked about having “nightmares about thousands of young people showing up to listen to him.” “Sylvia Renteria, yes, like the young men in uniforms at a rally in the ’30s,” replied the Twin Groves Middle School teacher. Pinta recently shared a Facebook post promoting a petition opposing efforts to recognize Charlie Kirk in Illinois School District 214. The petition also rejects plans for a public event honoring Kirk and his organization, Turning Point USA. In her post, Pinta urged supporters to sign, writing: “Opposing petition that you WILL want to sign, this one AGAINST glorifying Charlie Kirk.” CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () Opinion: I Worked for TPUSA — Glenbrook North’s TPUSA Denial Isn’t Just Wrong, It’s Un-American () Peter Christos, a former TPUSA staffer, speaking at the vigil held on September 14, 2025 in memory of slain TPUSA founder Charlie Kirk. (Peter Christos/Facebook) () By Peter Christos, Guest Contributor For far too long, Conservative students on High School and College campuses across the country have faced unfair treatment, being targeted by school administrations, victims of doxxing and even violent attacks, all simply for sharing their ideas and engaging in free speech debate. Just last week, we witnessed this heartbreaking reality when TPUSA Founder Charlie Kirk was tragically assassinated while speaking in front of thousands of students at Utah Valley University. As conservatives around the country mourned, prayed, and held vigils for Charlie, many on the left celebrated — a stark reminder of the deep divisions in our country. Attendees waiting for the vigil to begin. (Source: Sean Miles) At Glenbrook North, we see the struggle for students who are Pro-America and Pro-Free Speech. Last year, a large group of GBN Students attempted to start a Turning Point USA High School Chapter on campus. After meeting with the administration, they denied TPUSA students the right to start a Pro-America Club on campus. The reason given? That the school “already has a club like that.” But this simply isn’t true. A look at Glenbrook North’s official Clubs and Organizations list reveals no club shares the core values of Turning Point USA which include: promoting free speech and open dialogue; advocating for limited government; supporting free-market capitalism; celebrating American values and the Constitution, among many other things. The reality is clear: TPUSA was denied because it is considered a ‘Conservative’ organization. I speak from personal experience when I say Glenbrook North has shown bias, unfair treatment, and even allowed violence against Conservative students. Years later, nothing has changed to make the school a more inclusive place where all students feel welcome. Every student regardless of political beliefs, deserves to express their thoughts freely and safely. The Equal Access Act makes it clear that if one club is allowed, all others must be given equal access, regardless of political or ideological views. While Glenbrook North embraces ultra-liberal and Progressive clubs like Students Demand Action and GSA, it refuses to allow TPUSA (a 501(c)(3) non-profit) on campus. It is a shameful double standard for a school that prides itself on inclusivity to silence half its students. This is a clear violation of free speech and un-American. Following the tragic assassination of TPUSA Founder Charlie Kirk, numerous Glenbrook North students who personally knew him reached out to me to organize what we expected to be a small vigil in downtown Northbrook. What happened was the opposite. It was confirmed that over 1,500 people from our community showed up, 150 of them current Glenbrook North students, to honor the life and legacy of Charlie. So many members of the community showed up to pay their respects to Charlie, we had to move locations to accommodate the crowd. Students and community members from all political backgrounds came together to mourn and pray with us, because TPUSA and Charlie Kirk stood for freedom of debate and expression and didn’t deny or reject you based on your political beliefs. It was a somber, but unforgettable evening of unity and love, regardless of your political beliefs. This is something our country needs more of. The outpouring of support towards current TPUSA students at GBN from the Northbrook community has been inspiring. With the new school year starting, and in the wake of Charlie Kirk’s assassination, I urge Glenbrook North to reconsider its decision and allow Turning Point USA to exist on campus. We have no room left for division, bias, or political violence, at every level in this country. It must all be condemned and stopped. It’s time to come together, listen to every voice, and ensure every student has a seat at the table. This is our Turning Point America. body:
We’ve got a lot more work to do, and I’m sure as hell not going to let MAGA extremists flip this state red.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_em250916twdebhaaland?refcode=em20250916-4460&refcode2=4460_400544_LRXbNU&akid=4460%2E400544%2ELRXbNU)
Team, I wanted you to hear it from me first: **I’m running to continue serving as Governor of Minnesota.**
Here in Minnesota, we’ve cut child poverty, expanded labor rights, invested in education, made sure every student gets free breakfast and lunch at school, and so much more.
We’re putting people first — and giving folks the freedom to live their own lives the way they want to live them.
Butteam, everything we’re building is under attack. Donald Trump and his fellow extremists are dismantling basic services like Social Security and Medicare, leaving working families behind, and threatening our freedoms.
That’s why I’m running — because we’ve got a lot more work to do, and I’m sure as hell not going to let MAGA extremists flip this state red.
**[Will you stand with me and split a donation between my campaign and Deb Haaland to show that we are fired up and ready to win?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_em250916twdebhaaland?refcode=em20250916-4460&refcode2=4460_400544_LRXbNU&akid=4460%2E400544%2ELRXbNU)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_em250916twdebhaaland?refcode=em20250916-4460&refcode2=4460_400544_LRXbNU&akid=4460%2E400544%2ELRXbNU)**
Republicans want to gut your benefits and hand out tax breaks to billionaires. They think no one will notice. And if we do, they think we won’t fight back.
We’re going to prove them wrong. But to do it, we need the resources to fight back starting right now — there’s no time to waste.
**[If you're with me, pitch in and split a donation between my campaign and Deb Haaland today so we can continue showing the country that there is a better way forward.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_em250916twdebhaaland?refcode=em20250916-4460&refcode2=4460_400544_LRXbNU&akid=4460%2E400544%2ELRXbNU)**

Let’s get to work.
Tim Walz

| Please join us for our upcoming webinar: **From Wake-Up Call to Action Plan: COVID taught us—here’s how to be ready for the next pandemic**
**When:** Saturday, **Sept 27, 2025 at 9:00 AM PT/12:00 PM EST** Join Autism Health for our next live webinar with **Dr. Richard Bartlett** , a highly respected emergency room physician, public-health advocate, and innovator in pandemic treatment strategies. We’ll translate hard-won lessons from COVID into a clear, family-ready preparedness plan—what to stock, how to respond early, and how to think about risk with calm, common-sense steps. Dr. Bartlett is widely known for his early, patient-centered use of **inhaled budesonide** during the COVID-19 pandemic, and subsequent Oxford-led studies reported faster recovery in community patients who received early budesonide—insights that helped shape outpatient care discussions. You can explore more of his work at **[budesonideworks.com](https://autismhealth.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7c0b21e245e40197b3670bea2&id=f5c249f74f&e=3a42edfdc4)**. We’ll cover air, water, medicine-cabinet essentials, communication checklists, when to seek care, and how to separate signal from noise—so your family is prepared, not panicked. Everyone is required to register in advance for this webinar. We look forward to seeing you all there!

name: Team Rayfield
subject: Together we can stop Trump's illegal tariffs
body:
We keep beating Trump in court, and now we're headed to the US Supreme Court to block Trump's tariff scheme | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/danrayfield/together-we-can-stop-trumps-illegal-tariffs?e=1768325bd4)
---
| |
---
| | Friend,
President Trump is abusing his power to break the law to raise taxes on all of us all. [We need your help to stop him.](https://danrayfield.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f0c603f9d9801c198f6fc68fa&id=80c6292b69&e=1768325bd4)
Late last month we beat Trump in court _**once again**_ when a federal judge ruled that Trump’s regressive tariff taxes are unconstitutional. Our US Constitution gives Congress, not the president, the power to levy taxes – but Trump’s plan to raise taxes on everything from groceries to Christmas toys ignored what the Constitution requires. We sued, and we won. Trump has now appealed to the US Supreme Court, so we’re headed to Washington DC in November to argue on behalf of Oregonians and all Americans. We’ve won before, and we’ll be ready to beat him there again.
---
| [ ](https://danrayfield.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f0c603f9d9801c198f6fc68fa&id=9ef2d85a89&e=1768325bd4)
---
| This is a fight we can win, and will win, because we believe that there are still rules, that laws matter, and that for our state and country to thrive those laws have to be followed, even if you’re the president of the United States.
As your Attorney General, I will always stand up for Oregonians against powerful illegal interests. Our office will do everything we can to stop President Trump’s unlawful activity. But we can’t do it alone — we all need to be in this fight together.
Taking on Trump isn’t easy, and we need your help. Trump has the power of the federal government and the backing of billionaires. We have our own power. The power of our community and the power of truth and the power of law. [By donating $5, $10, or $20 to my campaign today](https://danrayfield.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f0c603f9d9801c198f6fc68fa&id=a27733b822&e=1768325bd4), you join me in this fight and give me the power to push back to protect all of us.
Join us — together we can make a difference.

Yours in the law,

Dan

Peter, I wanted to reach out personally to share this news with you:
**I’m officially running for reelection as Governor of Minnesota, because our work to make our state the best place in America to live, work, and raise a family isn’t finished.**
[**If you’re with me, can I count on you to chip in $10, $25, $50, or whatever works for you to become a Founding Donor to our campaign today? Knowing I have your early support in this race would mean the world to me.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115339382/569981880/2129968691?refcode=body&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDc0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YmVjNjEyMi0yYjkzLWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=d-vVEuEi8Nm2fAoT5G0uyD1wuGpPayj0tpuMXwkKhlI=)
I grew up in Butte, Nebraska – a town of 400 people. There were 24 kids in my high school class. Living in a small town, you learn early on what it means to look out for your neighbors and to serve others.
That call to service is what led me to enlist in the Army National Guard just two days after my 17th birthday. I was proud to wear the uniform of this country for the next 24 years.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115339388/569981897/2129968691?refcode=body&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDc0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YmVjNjEyMi0yYjkzLWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=d-vVEuEi8Nm2fAoT5G0uyD1wuGpPayj0tpuMXwkKhlI=)
My drive to serve others eventually set me on a new path: teaching. My wife Gwen and I met while teaching high school. Kids carry their whole lives with them into the classroom and Gwen and I got to know our students and see the obstacles they faced. **It was my experience as a teacher and my passion for education that led me to run for governor.**
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115339392/569981909/2129968691?refcode=body&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDc0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YmVjNjEyMi0yYjkzLWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=d-vVEuEi8Nm2fAoT5G0uyD1wuGpPayj0tpuMXwkKhlI=)**
Serving as Governor of Minnesota has been the honor of my life, and I couldn’t be prouder of the progress we’ve won. From providing universal free school meals for students, to protecting reproductive freedom, and cutting taxes for the middle class, we’ve secured tangible results that Minnesotans can actually feel.
The values that inspired me to serve our country in uniform, become an educator, and run for governor are the same ones I still carry with me each day as I work for the people of Minnesota. I still believe in helping our neighbors, protecting our freedoms, and investing in the future for our next generation. And I believe that, despite Donald Trump and MAGA’s attempts to tear us apart, we are still all in this together.
**Right now, we have an opportunity to continue delivering progress for Minnesotans – but only if we hold onto this Governor’s seat.** That’s why I’m asking you to have my back today, Peter.

| | | Hi friend, it's Senator Kirsten Gillibrand. I am excited and honored to serve as your Chair of the DSCC.

My entire career, I've believed in **the power of grassroots activism.** I know that campaigns -- and Senate majorities -- are won by the people who put in the work, from volunteers knocking on doors and stuffing envelopes to supporters sharing their priorities. _And that last piece is why I want to hear from you._

**[Today, I'm pleased to invite you to join my official DSCC Focus Group. Flipping the Senate depends on knowing what issues and messages matter most to this team, so it's important that I personally hear from top supporters like you. Your feedback will enable us to build our strategy to take back the majority -- so please, will you take my survey before midnight?](http://go.dscc.org/go/21861?ask=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20250916-KirstenGillibrand-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20250916-KirstenGillibrand-NewChairFocusGroup-Pros-sl1&akid=21234%2E9716520%2EF4xlfT)**

Kirsten

* **Undermining public trust:** From attacking public institutions to casting doubt on elections, Trump is laying the groundwork to destroy public trust in nonpartisan communication of any kind. * **Shaping a legal and policy legacy:** Trump's party is already planning for further executive overreach, voter suppression tactics, attacks on reproductive rights and other fundamental freedoms, and plotting Supreme Court picks that could shape America for generations.

Donald Trump is building a culture of corruption in the White House and on the campaign trail. His power is fueled by secret money, rigged rules, and a complete disregard for accountability. He's already laying the groundwork for 2028 — sowing distrust, stockpiling cash, and propping up JD Vance as his puppet for a third Trump presidency. **= | = Here's what's happening, plain and simple: Undermining public trust: From attacking public institutions to casting doubt on elections, Trump is laying the groundwork to destroy public trust in nonpartisan communication of any kind. subject: I’m running
body:
We’re putting people first — and giving folks the freedom to live their own lives the way they want to live them.
| [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/4811?t=1&akid=5606%2E196590%2EO9CjGo)
---
Team, I wanted you to hear it from me first: **I’m running to continue serving as Governor of Minnesota.**

Here in Minnesota, we’ve cut child poverty, expanded labor rights, invested in education, made sure every student gets free breakfast and lunch at school, and so much more.

We’re putting people first — and giving folks the freedom to live their own lives the way they want to live them.

But team, everything we’re building is under attack. Donald Trump and his fellow extremists are dismantling basic services like Social Security and Medicare, leaving working families behind, and threatening our freedoms.

That’s why I’m running — because we’ve got a lot more work to do, and I’m sure as hell not going to let MAGA extremists flip this state red.

[_**Will you stand with me and split a donation between my campaign and The Long Run to show that we are fired up and ready to win?**_](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/4811?t=2&akid=5606%2E196590%2EO9CjGo)
| [DONATE ](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/4811?t=3&akid=5606%2E196590%2EO9CjGo)

Republicans want to gut your benefits and hand out tax breaks to billionaires. They think no one will notice. And if we do, they think we won’t fight back.

We’re going to prove them wrong. But to do it, we need the resources to fight back starting right now — there’s no time to waste.

---|---|---|---|---
I grew up in Butte, Nebraska – a town of 400 people. There were 24 kids in my high school class. Living in a small town, you learn early on what it means to look out for your neighbors and to serve others.

That call to service is what led me to enlist in the Army National Guard just two days after my 17th birthday. I was proud to wear the uniform of this country for the next 24 years.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115340945/569986938/186868260?refcode=em25_250916_walz_fndd_gq_act___AB_ettx&utm_campaign=em25_250916_walz_fndd_gq_act___AB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=039cd757-2f93-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDM5Y2Q3NTctMmY5My1mMDExLWI0ODQtNjA0NWJkZWI3NDEzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=hkcvchkynDBoHaDK6J0Vbm3FqgyyL3IDWuOEsBzelow=)
My drive to serve others eventually set me on a new path: teaching. My wife Gwen and I met while teaching high school. Kids carry their whole lives with them into the classroom and Gwen and I got to know our students and see the obstacles they faced. **It was my experience as a teacher and my passion for education that led me to run for governor.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115340949/569986948/186868260?refcode=em25_250916_walz_fndd_gq_act___AB_ettx&utm_campaign=em25_250916_walz_fndd_gq_act___AB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=039cd757-2f93-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDM5Y2Q3NTctMmY5My1mMDExLWI0ODQtNjA0NWJkZWI3NDEzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=hkcvchkynDBoHaDK6J0Vbm3FqgyyL3IDWuOEsBzelow=)
Serving as Governor of Minnesota has been the honor of my life, and I couldn’t be prouder of the progress we’ve won. From providing universal free school meals for students, to protecting reproductive freedom, and cutting taxes for the middle class, we’ve secured tangible results that Minnesotans can actually feel.

The values that inspired me to serve our country in uniform, become an educator, and run for governor are the same ones I still carry with me each day as I work for the people of Minnesota. I still believe in helping our neighbors, protecting our freedoms, and investing in the future for our next generation. And I believe that, despite Donald Trump and MAGA’s attempts to tear us apart, we are still all in this together.

**Right now, we have an opportunity to continue delivering progress for Minnesotans – but only if we hold onto this Governor seat.** _That’s why I’m asking you to have my back today, Peter._

[**Would you split a donation between my campaign and In This Together PAC? Thank you in advance for your support.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115340950/569986952/186868260?refcode=em25_250916_walz_fndd_gq_act___AB_ettx&utm_campaign=em25_250916_walz_fndd_gq_act___AB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=039cd757-2f93-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDM5Y2Q3NTctMmY5My1mMDExLWI0ODQtNjA0NWJkZWI3NDEzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=hkcvchkynDBoHaDK6J0Vbm3FqgyyL3IDWuOEsBzelow=)

I’ll be in touch soon,

Tim Walz

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[“God’s timing, not mine”: Rose Pugliese on closing one chapter and trusting what comes next](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Rose Pugliese describes her resignation from the Colorado House as one of the hardest decisions of her life, shaped by prayer, sacrifice — and the voices of her children.
“I truly want to follow God’s path and I think part of God’s path for me now is making sure I prioritize my children,” she explained.
For the House minority leader and single mom, that path now means stepping back from the Capitol and returning to Mesa County. Her choice, effective Sept. 15, came during a week she described as overwhelming — from the Evergreen school shooting to the assassination of Charlie Kirk to the grief of 9/11 remembrances.
What finally cut through the politics was a child’s honesty. “Mommy, we feel like you’re not OK, and we want you to be OK.”

**[Elon Musk Slams “Soft-on-Crime” Policies in Clash With Governor Polis](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WESTERN JOURNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Elon Musk blasted Governor Jared Polis after Weld County Sheriff Steve Reams revealed he was forced to release Debisa Ephraim, a violent criminal deemed incompetent to stand trial, under a law Polis signed in 2024.

* The law, House Bill 24-1034, has led to other dangerous releases, including a sex offender in Aurora, sparking outrage from law enforcement who warn someone will eventually be seriously harmed.

* Musk called the policy “insane” on X, highlighting Colorado’s soft-on-crime approach and drawing national attention to Polis’ role in enabling violent offenders back onto the streets.

name: Tucker Carlson
subject: Charlie ran his race — now we run ours
body:
Right now, Charlie would say, “Don’t you dare quit”

| | | [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bbn0/?__vbtrk=MzE5ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzE5ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Friend,
---
I don’t write emails like this often. But right now? After what happened to Charlie... _I can’t stay quiet._**Charlie Kirk was my friend.** Not just someone I admired, but someone I loved and respected deeply. Losing him was devastating.
---
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bbn0/?__vbtrk=MzE5ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzE5ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
In many ways, all of us share in this loss. Charlie fought every day of his life for each one of us... fighting to keep America as great, free, and prosperous. No one I know ever fought for that harder than Charlie.America won't ever be the same. **No one can ever replace him — but we can make sure his legacy continues on. **_We owe him that._ Because if you knew Charlie, you would know exactly what he would say to us right now: _**"Don’t you dare quit."**_ Charlie poured his heart into building a movement to save America. He believed in young people. He believed in ordinary Americans. And he believed that even in our darkest hours, America was the beacon of goodness, freedom, and truth.That’s what the Turning Point movement was all about — and Charlie gave everything he had to that fight.**And our task now is not only to protect what he built — it’s to grow it bigger, stronger, and bolder than anyone ever thought possible. ** More students. More churches. More families. More courage from everyday Americans to stand up and fight for what is right.Turning Point USA was Charlie’s vehicle to save America. **He didn’t just start a movement... _he started a revival. _**And now, friend, we must carry that forward. If you share the same sense of responsibility that I do to honor Charlie’s work and press on with his vision...** _Then please join me in keeping his fight alive by making a gift to Turning Point USA today. _** **[Let’s make Turning Point USA the biggest thing that this nation has ever seen... bigger than Charlie ever thought possible. That’s how we honor him best.](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bbn0/?__vbtrk=MzE5ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzE5ODkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**

Charlie fought every day of his life for each one of us... fighting to keep America as great, free, and prosperous. No one I know ever fought for that harder than Charlie.America won't ever be the same. No one can ever replace him — but we can make sure his legacy continues on. We owe him that. Because if you knew Charlie, you would know exactly what he would say to us right now: "Don’t you dare quit." Charlie poured his heart into building a movement to save America. If you share the same sense of responsibility that I do to honor Charlie’s work and press on with his vision... name: Jenny, All On The Line
subject: Why this win in Utah means so much
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
Help ensure we can keep mobilizing for the fights ahead
|
---

Peter:
Right now, people across Utah are celebrating after a district court struck down the state’s gerrymandered map.
As someone who spent a significant amount of time working in Utah this past redistricting cycle, I can’t say enough about the weight of this moment. I’m deeply proud of all the work the fair maps movement put in to fight for fair maps where voters' voices can truly be heard.
**As we rightfully celebrate this moment, I’m also reflecting on what it took to get here.**
I saw firsthand how Utah’s congressional map disenfranchised my Latin community on the west side of Salt Lake. I watched hours of public testimony of voters who took time from their busy schedules to share how unfair the maps were, especially to the people of Salt Lake City. And I witnessed young voters propose their own maps to the commission and really immerse themselves in the process to fight back in whatever way they could.
**Peter, this was a hard-won victory. But it doesn’t just signify a win for Utahns. It’s an important moment for the entire country, because it shows us that fairness is winning — even in states that aren’t typically battlegrounds.**
So as we look ahead to the map redraw in Utah, I’m also thinking about the redraw in Ohio, the gerrymandered map that just passed in Texas, and ongoing threats in Missouri, Indiana, and Florida. All On The Line is relying on the strength of this grassroots movement to ensure we can keep mobilizing for the fights ahead to promote free and fair elections and to protect our democracy.

clean_body: Help ensure we can keep mobilizing for the fights ahead | Peter: Right now, people across Utah are celebrating after a district court struck down the state’s gerrymandered map. As someone who spent a significant amount of time working in Utah this past redistricting cycle, I can’t say enough about the weight of this moment. I’m deeply proud of all the work the fair maps movement put in to fight for fair maps where voters' voices can truly be heard. As we rightfully celebrate this moment, I’m also reflecting on what it took to get here. I saw firsthand how Utah’s congressional map disenfranchised my Latin community on the west side of Salt Lake. I watched hours of public testimony of voters who took time from their busy schedules to share how unfair the maps were, especially to the people of Salt Lake City. And I witnessed young voters propose their own maps to the commission and really immerse themselves in the process to fight back in whatever way they could. Peter, this was a hard-won victory. But it doesn’t just signify a win for Utahns. It’s an important moment for the entire country, because it shows us that fairness is winning — even in states that aren’t typically battlegrounds. So as we look ahead to the map redraw in Utah, I’m also thinking about the redraw in Ohio, the gerrymandered map that just passed in Texas, and ongoing threats in Missouri, Indiana, and Florida. We’ve got a lot more work to do, and I’m sure as hell not going to let MAGA extremists flip this state red.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_20250916_1_em250916twpappas?refcode=em20250916-2382&amount=5&refcode2=2382_582294_acfMz_&akid=2382%2E582294%2EacfMz_)
Team, I wanted you to hear it from me first: **I’m running to continue serving as Governor of Minnesota.**
Here in Minnesota, we’ve cut child poverty, expanded labor rights, invested in education, made sure every student gets free breakfast and lunch at school, and so much more.

clean_body: Our duty now: carry Charlie’s mission forward. Right now, Charlie would say, "Don't you dare quit" | | | Friend, I don't write emails like this often. But right now? After what happened to Charlie... I can 't stay quiet.Charlie Kirk was my friend. Not just someone I admired, but someone I loved and respected deeply. Losing him was devastating. In many ways, all of us share in this loss. Charlie fought every day of his life for each one of us... fighting to keep America as great, free, and prosperous. No one I know ever fought for that harder than Charlie.America won't ever be the same. No one can ever replace him -- but we can make sure his legacy continues on. We owe him that. Because if you knew Charlie, you would know exactly what he would say to us right now: "Don 't you dare quit."Charlie poured his heart into building a movement to save America. He believed in young people. He believed in ordinary Americans. And he believed that even in our darkest hours, America was the beacon of goodness, freedom, and truth.That's what the Turning Point movement was all about -- and Charlie gave everything he had to that fight.And our task now is not only to protect what he built -- it's to grow it bigger, stronger, and bolder than anyone ever thought possible. More students. More churches. More families. More courage from everyday Americans to stand up and fight for what is right.Turning Point USA was Charlie's vehicle to save America. He didn 't just start a movement... he started a revival. And now, Friend, we must carry that forward. If you share the same sense of responsibility that I do to honor Charlie's work and press on with his vision... Then please join me in keeping his fight alive by making a gift to Turning Point USA today. Rest in peace, Charlie. We'll carry the torch you lit from here. For Charlie, Tucker Carlson 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

name: Chris Ahuja
subject: Fox News said ‘just kill ‘em.’ Here’s my answer.”
body:
No one is disposable

| | | | | | Dear Peter,**Every day, we see the tents, the encampments, and the human suffering.** Too many of our unhoused neighbors are struggling with a lack of affordable housing and untreated mental health conditions.Republicans in Congress want to respond with punishment and criminalization, and**last week a Fox News channel host Brian Kilmeade suggested death by lethal injection.**
During a conversation about public money spent on trying to help homeless people, a Fox News anchor Lawrence Jones suggested that those who didn't accept services offered to them should be jailed.
**"Or involuntary lethal injection, or something," Brian Kilmeade said. "Just kill 'em."**
**This abject lack of empathy is shameful and disgusting.** We cannot solve the homelessness crisis unless we solve the mental health crisis.
**That means:**
* **Investing in supportive housing with wraparound mental health care.**
* **Funding treatment centers and community clinics so care is available before a crisis spirals out of control.**
* **Training first responders to help with empathy, not handcuffs.**

**This is not just policy, it’s personal.** I’ve met with families across our district who have watched loved ones slip through the cracks of a broken system. They know that housing and health must go hand-in-hand.
We need leaders in Washington with the courage to say it plainly: **Homelessness will not be solved by police sweeps or soundbites; it will be solved by investing in people.**
**To get there, we need to win this race.** We need a campaign strong enough to take on Brad Sherman and the special interests who think the status quo is acceptable.

In the grand auditorium of the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts, a venue etched with the memory of another assassinated leader, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. approached the podium on a humid September evening for the prayer vigil for Charlie Kirk, the 31-year-old conservative activist gunned down just days earlier on a Utah college campus.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/df67105e-cee7-46ff-958c-dfb2876381c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Hundreds had queued quietly outside, bullhorns of protesters faintly audible in the distance, as a capacity crowd filled the seats. Kirk, founder of Turning Point USA, had been felled by a single shot to the neck during a speaking tour stop at Utah Valley University--a targeted attack that authorities quickly deemed ideologically motivated.
Before RFK Jr. could even began speaking, the crowd erupted in chants of "USA," a raw outpouring of grief and resolve.
When he began, his voice steady but laced with the weight of familial ghosts, he could have just as easily been speaking about his father or his uncle.
_**"There are millions and millions of kids around the country who he inspired who now want to live like Charlie Kirk. And that's a great thing for our country ... I want to start by telling you a story about my 17-year-old niece, Zoe. She's getting ready to go to college in Europe. And her mother asked her what she was packing, and she said, "I'm packing my Bible." And her mom said, "Why are you doing that?" And she said, "I want to live like Charlie Kirk."**_

The vigil itself was attended by over 85 members of Congress, White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt, Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard, and House Speaker Mike Johnson. Organized by Turning Point USA alumni, it blended worship services with heartfelt tributes, underscoring Kirk's devout Christian faith and his role in mobilizing young conservatives. Leavitt recalled Kirk's support for her 2022 congressional bid, crediting him with dismantling the Republican establishment. Gabbard praised his commitment to defeating bad ideas with better ones, a nod to free speech as the evening's recurring theme.
But it was RFK Jr., the Health and Human Services Secretary and a former Democrat turned Trump ally, with his personal experience of loss of family to assassin's bullets and tragedy that gave listeners chills.
_**" After my brother David died in 1984, I asked my mom--I said, "Does the hole that they leave in you when they die, does it ever get any smaller?" And she said, "No. It never gets any smaller, but our job is to build ourselves bigger around the hole." We do that by taking the best virtues and character traits of the person that we lost and using discipline and restraint and practice integrating those character traits into our own character. And in doing that, we make ourselves larger, and the hole gets proportionally smaller. And we also give the person a kind of immortality because the best parts of them are now living on in us."**_
His presence at the Kennedy Center--a building honoring his uncle, President John F. Kennedy, assassinated in 1963--added layers of poignant irony to an already emotionally charged moment. Here was a man whose father, Robert F. Kennedy, was slain in 1968 amid his presidential campaign, delivering words on yet another political killing. In this moment, in this place, RFK Jr's words were what a nation and a movement in mourning needed to hear.
RFK Jr.'s speech wove personal anecdotes with broader reflection, humanizing the tragedy while confronting its historical echoes. He described meeting Kirk on his podcast (in what he mistakenly said 2001--likely a slip for 2021, as Kirk was only 7 in 2001 and his show began in 2020 a fact which **[drew pathetic online mockery](https://substack.com/redirect/9bdeee52-a3e2-4e38-b678-b623024a2262?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from outlets like The New Republic.)
RFK Jr. portrayed Kirk as a _**"relentless and courageous crusader for free speech,"**_ the _**"primary architect"**_ of his own political unification with President Trump, and whose death inspired his 17-year-old niece to pack a Bible for college abroad, vowing to _**"live like Charlie Kirk."**_
He recounted a pivotal exchange where Kirk asked if he feared death;
_**" I had a conversation once with Charlie where we were talking about the danger that we both faced from challenging entrenched interests. And he asked me if I was scared to die. I said to him, "There's a lot worse things than dying." Chief among them is losing our constitutional rights and having our children raised in slavery. And I said to him at that time, "Sometimes our only consolation is that we can die with our boots on. We can die fighting for these things ... Charlie gave his life so that the rest of us would not have to suffer those fates worse than death."**_
The words hung heavy, forever linking Kirk's demise to the lineage of silenced truth-tellers in American history, a bridge between Kirk's youthful fervor and the Kennedys' storied legacy of loss. The parallels he drew to his family's tragedies--JFK, RFK Sr., reminding the audience that bullets have long targeted those who challenge power. _**"Once again, a bullet has silenced the most eloquent truth-teller of an era,"**_ he had posted earlier, a sentiment that echoed through the vigil.
The vigil's raw emotion contrasted sharply with the media's divided response, highlighting a cultural chasm in comprehending such violence. Progressive outlets like The New Republic fixated on RFK Jr.'s date slip, framing it as emblematic of conservative delusion, while ignoring the speech's substantive gravity. This tone-deafness, missed the sea change moment that had occurred in America: Kirk was no mere podcaster but a kingmaker who influenced millions, including RFK Jr.'s endorsement of Trump which may have swayed independent voters.
If you speak to any older Americans they can always tell you _**" where they were when they heard that JFK had been shot."**_ One suspects for countless young Americans today, Kirk's death will be that for them. A myriad of lives have been affected and a myriad more have taken a new direction because of what transpired on that ordinary afternoon on September 10th.
RFK Jr.'s address, delivered under the Kennedy Center's hallowed arches, should act as a North Star amid the turmoil that the nation will have to endure, it will teach us how to fight on bravely, how to cope with the grief that we have been left with and how to confront political violence not with vengeance but with renewed commitment to dialogue and rights.
America has lost some of its best to political violence. RFK Jr more than anyone can teach us how we move forward together afterwards.

name: MAHA Action
subject: ALL HANDS ON DECK: Stand with Secretary Kennedy — Take Action Now
body:
Tell the Senate: protect transparency, protect our kids’ health. Call, email, and show up.

| | | [ ](https://www.mahaaction.com/?e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=stand_with_bobby_rapid_1&n=1)
---
---
MAHA Warriors, This is an all-hands moment. Tomorrow, the Senate HELP Committee will hold a hearing that industry lobbyists hope to use to undermine Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and stall long-overdue reform at HHS. The hearing is framed as “radical transparency,” but the pressure campaign against RFK is already in motion. We cannot let special interests define the narrative or derail the work to protect children’s health.
### Why this matters right now
* Powerful lobbies have coordinated a media and Hill push to force RFK out, instead of debating facts in the open.
* Tomorrow’s hearing will shape public health policy and the future of transparency and gold-standard science at CDC and across government.

---
---
### What to do in the next 24 hours
1. Tell the Senate HELP Committee and your senators to support transparency and gold-standard science **by calling the numbers above.** You can also send a message by using [the one-click action portal](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=gYUPsZlV8vQD3dzXxGaMj-SUMeW-TJmJOB-9bPZ2kaCR3-07cyDTOS2u7pHpWbscVPN2NZjcgsQiQ9-fQj3DTg&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=stand_with_bobby_rapid_1&n=2).
2. **If you’re in or near DC, show up in person.** Here are the details: [Senate HELP hearing: “Restoring Trust Through Radical Transparency”](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=ecbTWdb_9-KtUqkP1flx8N8F2fuDBVSxpQVq3X6LeGIAky_fT21-aIX7VO2Iatg_h7uymKyRdHY5P88dhObR-ZuxFV6THqhfSsRi_JlBGZiI5wKRj2dNNmN-FRZL5b3dj9xmLwALt4fCwTlwclkqjeWvmavu_QV5IERhiJTQBAKZcbxkFPGeGrR6uJKKzDTDjwQLjKTxcqbrdFSyRG1w9KrJ-C1AEwoNk2EnXsPmPzVMd1l1f04de2D45jMWr_xgeGBip9I6yEPaNMxnro3ZhQ&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=stand_with_bobby_rapid_1&n=3) Wed, Sept 17, 10:00 a.m. 430 Dirksen Senate Office Building
3. **Amplify the message on social media today.** [Share the action link](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=gYUPsZlV8vQD3dzXxGaMj-SUMeW-TJmJOB-9bPZ2kaCR3-07cyDTOS2u7pHpWbscVPN2NZjcgsQiQ9-fQj3DTg&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=stand_with_bobby_rapid_1&n=4) and call for support in transparency and accountability.

This is the moment to stand up and be counted. Write. Call. Show up. Don’t let lobbyists and PR firms decide the future of American health policy. Together, we can protect transparency, return to gold-standard science, and Make America Healthy Again. **MAHA Action**

| |
#### I am not a career politician.

### **I’m a Navy Veteran.**
---
| | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://kinterforcongress.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f6a723b5c3bc1add1f7a8ca4d&id=d844a832e9&e=d995135712)
| | For nearly a decade, I put my life on the line for this country. I supervised a nuclear reactor on a warship, a job that demanded absolute integrity and a profound sense of duty. I did it because I believe in an America that is worth fighting for.
---
| |
## I didn't do it just to come home and watch our government be sold off to the highest bidder.
---
| | But that is exactly what is happening. My opponent, Cory Mills, is one of the most corrupt incumbents in the country. He is a living embodiment of a broken political system that serves corporate PACs and wealthy donors, not the working families of our community.
---
| | This is why my campaign is different. We are not taking a dime of corporate PAC money. We are on the ground every single day, with food drives and clothing drives, proving that our campaign is about real service and real results, not just empty promises.
---
| |
### **On September 30th, we have to file our official fundraising report with the FEC. This is the moment when the entire political establishment will look at our numbers to decide if a grassroots, people-powered movement like ours is "viable."**
---
|
---
| | My opponent will have a massive number, funded by the very special interests that are rigging the system against you. Our campaign is measured differently. Our strength isn't in the size of the checks, but in the **number of people who chip in.**
---
| |
#### **I am personally asking you: will you rush a donation of $10, $25, or whatever you can afford right now to help us hit our end-of-quarter goal and prove the strength of our movement?**

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CONROY FOR CONGRESS
body:
| | | | | | | _You're receiving this message because you stood with us during the 2024 election, or a mutual friend shared your information with us. We’re proud to have you in our network, but if you'd prefer not to receive these updates, you can unsubscribe_[ _here_](https://conroy4congress.us17.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=dc047fbc65030d4c4bcc44d19&id=2c7cc2a69f&t=b&e=a7b299e420&c=0dcef8cd09) _._

[|

| | Peter,

**Today is National Voter Registration Day – the perfect time to ask:**_**Are you registered to vote?**_
---
| [YES](https://conroy4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc047fbc65030d4c4bcc44d19&id=1b6aa6f975&e=a7b299e420) | | [NO](https://conroy4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc047fbc65030d4c4bcc44d19&id=77ab5c0765&e=a7b299e420)
---|---|---
| | If you’re already registered, thank you for making your voice heard. If you’re not registered, or if you’re unsure, take just a few minutes today to register, check your status, or update your information [here](https://conroy4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc047fbc65030d4c4bcc44d19&id=becc8b49bf&e=a7b299e420).

**Because 2026 will be here before we know it – and it won’t be just another election year. It will be a defining moment for Eastern Washington.

Together, we can choose a better path forward. One with compassionate, experienced, and accountable leadership right here at home.** _What we do now – getting registered, getting organized, and making sure no one is left behind – will determine whether we’re ready to seize that opportunity._

With voting rights under attack across the country, including efforts to weaken Washington’s universal vote by mail system, the stakes couldn’t be higher. Here in Eastern Washington, rural communities, students, seniors, families serving abroad, and so many more all rely on mail ballots to make their voices heard, no matter where they are. Without them, tens of thousands of our neighbors would be silenced.

We can’t afford to let that happen. Not here. Not now.

**Let’s be ready. Let’s make sure our vote counts. And let’s build the future Eastern Washington deserves.**

Thank you,

Team Conroy for Congress

---

And, if I’m being candid, I’m sick and tired of Democrats without a backbone who refuse to stand up to this administration. Florida is winnable. And right now, we have a golden opportunity to flip this Senate seat, and with it, the balance of power. If we succeed, Democrats can finally pass bold legislation to help American families like mine, and yours. If we fail, the GOP stays in charge and Donald Trump will have a rubber stamp for his dictatorship. | I am a Democrat because I know what it feels like to struggle, to be left out, to need someone in your corner. My dad worked at Rikers and multiple jobs to make ends meet. My mom fought like hell to get Social Security Disability benefits so she could survive her lifelong illness. When the going got really tough, I delivered groceries to help make ends meet and keep my family afloat. Let’s be real: Washington is broken. While MAGA Republicans push their extreme agenda – banning abortion, gutting voting rights, protecting billionaires, and turning a blind eye to gun violence – too many Democrats remain silent. I’ve seen what happens when people back down from a fight. And I’m done waiting. [Washington needs a fighter. Not another Trump lapdog. So please, join our movement from Week One and split a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action right now to help me win in Florida >> ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T376ddf5e-8a38-4ffe-a1f3-d7a34988563f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Hi, it's Raul, **I'm working overtime on the issues that matter** : lowering grocery costs, strengthening our economy, and ensuring quality, accessible healthcare. When I was a student, pursuing my Master's in Public Policy and my Master's in Public Health, I was taught that effective and influential policy requires working with data and facts. **But here's the problem** — _Republicans use alternative facts to shape their dangerous policies._ Whether it’s their policies on vaccine safety, tariffs, public education, or public funding for scientific research, the MAGA agenda is based on extremist beliefs and not reality. I'm not afraid to call them out on basing public policing on fake facts and their extremist agenda, even when it makes me a target. **That's exactly why they're coming after me.** The FEC fundraising deadline is coming up on September 30. If we can show grassroots support behind my campaign, Republicans will know that we are not backing down. Peter,

Hispanic Heritage Month started yesterday, and I’m taking this time to reflect on our culture, celebrate our contributions, and honor the sacrifices of those who came before us.

For me, this month is deeply personal. As a Colombian immigrant, I grew up watching my parents work hard, make sacrifices, and build a life for our family here in America. They taught me the values of resilience, perseverance, and community — values that still guide me every single day.

**I am so proud to be Latina.** And despite the attacks our community faces daily from the current administration, we must stick together, lift each other up, and celebrate our _cultura preciosa._

Every day, my heritage reminds me why I am running for Congress. Every family, no matter where they came from, deserves the chance to succeed and thrive. And if elected, I would be proud to make history as the **first Hispanic woman ever elected to Congress from Pennsylvania.**

I’m humbled to have the support of organizations like **BOLD PAC** and **Latino Victory Fund** , who are committed to building Latino political power and uplifting voices like mine. But this campaign won’t be won by endorsements alone, it will be powered by grassroots supporters like you.

In the State Senate, he is committed to preventing new fossil fuel infrastructure and holding polluters accountable — a pivotal fight in one of the nation’s most fossil-fuel-entrenched states.

name: Governor Scott Walker
subject: A Vision for WI and the future: Building on our Conservative Success
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Forward USA Federal Political Action Committee
body:
| | | | Eliminate the income tax, freeze property taxes, and put students first. Here's my plan.
---
Hi Peter,
When I was first elected Governor, we set out on a bold path to move Wisconsin forward. We proved that conservative principles—fiscal responsibility, a strong economy, and common-sense reforms—could make a real difference in people's lives.
That same fighting spirit is needed now more than ever. The challenges we face demand a clear vision and a commitment to action, not empty promises. My vision for Wisconsin is simple yet powerful, and it's built on the values we share.
**Economic Freedom & Fiscal Responsibility**
I believe we must continue to put taxpayers first. We should:
* Eliminate the state income tax and freeze property taxes.

The __Institute for Reforming Government__ has helped push this along in the state of Wisconsin. I've been very supportive of their efforts, which you can see [_here_](https://u29856681.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.BdhjT3EcJBP2yWXmot-2FdEOGO8utkEQmlkGzWP36REdKQMo9t54RyhtbKBBHWPMzOzBGo7hsamNj9D3-2B6u3UKsB7uiQ-2FYvlo2jMuaYk8mDdlp7YFy8IbHRfqNbolFIe47ik6eEtYtsSho7yrzTwVJMUD2irvdoQMv7cBlvpT9Pjk-3DI2kb_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVDHKEOVw9cuvROXrcAsxwuAXpTiIzdbz4tu8qtzPkPgz3Rb45xRo37axdRsvzGoo3hYChZclIse3lYd2SfSQWsxkFh4-2Bag9WGwEWQVYJkruyiV4klpBZv7J18290dA2Dc-2Bx6kvr1jLSGMTGwQY-2FiNqA5iqW9RBlm0BSZLUVQqTBmY6oFJxtbbqW4AUCRoPUdYC5dO9oan1QzM5b-2B-2Fp12BJqESYfj-2FIPCi0spO-2Bv69BCVwX6yFaCvEHbBLAEX4KO-2BJgF6ys-2B6QTsiRg2ydNGxW5A104gTJWL41k0hsFjtgUWLH433IyYrqrp8yfa9huba-2FszfRWhMtOl0sCDMJxRusg-2B).

* Require balanced budgets with surpluses, [_just like we did when I was in office_](https://u29856681.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.BdhjT3EcJBP2yWXmot-2FdEK8F5WBVxnli3OznI2CGSe-2BWlnPmrZDK9xsOPxIkU0uAvVXF6u-2BpSxOmqc8tuWBFJPXe7xLuqpCCVwFf-2B2XnkrnBa8XtIbiuBBFA1-2F5IitlkW5oRljjQWRsit-2FvcrLAAkjEQZxsKZAGMM588CyTpaHg-3DyxBn_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVDHKEOVw9cuvROXrcAsxwuAXpTiIzdbz4tu8qtzPkPgz3Rb45xRo37axdRsvzGoo3hYChZclIse3lYd2SfSQWsxkFh4-2Bag9WGwEWQVYJkruyiV4klpBZv7J18290dA2Dc-2Bx6kvr1jLSGMTGwQY-2FiNqA5iqW9RBlm0BSZLUVQqTBmd-2BeR9SHAgLmY-2BF-2BRzOEJOhLxBt7uRajbWTvpOjN9SSDynjwtTlBUBWDbjKfgTyXLKH2kafFBqJAUspULdGojSZnkqLMlIHcsnNtcpxXVvKbBaZu3azV-2BNiv5ybV5qQ-2BF6vmqOv2YndMsMQpN2xOqrPLb1gxAvbbnhfsx5jdYMSO).
* Cut bureaucratic red tape to unleash our entrepreneurs and job creators.
* Protect our state from foreign influence by banning China from owning farmland or businesses in Wisconsin.
* Make healthcare more transparent and affordable by removing restrictions on consumers and requiring price transparency.
* Keep our talented young people here by freezing UW tuition and promoting opportunities for graduates to stay in our great state.

**Education Reform & Student Success**
Our children's future is too important to be left to the status quo. We need to empower parents and students, not systems. That's why I support:

* Education funding that follows students to the school that best fits their needs.
* [_Banning cell phones in schools to end distractions and improve learning._](https://u29856681.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.BdhjT3EcJBP2yWXmot-2FdEGabwhgepTg94pjuqiWtD3PYA6gYSi5bvGgvwt-2B-2BApJ9xXEFjRY3m4u-2BsjVn9SXhDbYng8LPVPv1P4JZdEDSU0TZQYXAzH56VMKCeyBLXnv-2BltkdoQDA65L-2Bd9H-2FNVqCrKk4HYJEPW1e-2Bogufo7ic-2Fo-3DW1zt_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVDHKEOVw9cuvROXrcAsxwuAXpTiIzdbz4tu8qtzPkPgz3Rb45xRo37axdRsvzGoo3hYChZclIse3lYd2SfSQWsxkFh4-2Bag9WGwEWQVYJkruyiV4klpBZv7J18290dA2Dc-2Bx6kvr1jLSGMTGwQY-2FiNqA5iqW9RBlm0BSZLUVQqTBmcgVP-2FG4pPu1Fv-2F6TrwdE3H8mW9EXEPmm-2BI3jxxqemN-2Fg4TcpcmzgtizrzY31g0iGGpconLR0QV8JQnMxKoO9S7fcMNbmRSQx6ZqFPhEK6NkUWcoKpCOIFTFhq4ICC1f-2F7OCDqY5j8EQYSwxs5ZDsdBHh3Z-2FcMIveWLd013HdpNT)
* A renewed focus on American values by requiring every student to have at least one course in American history and government, including reading the Declaration of Independence and the U.S. Constitution, and requiring every graduate to pass the U.S. Citizenship Test.

**Public Safety & The Rule of Law** Safe communities are the foundation of a prosperous state. We must stand with the brave men and women of law enforcement and send a clear message to criminals. We need to:

* Keep violent criminals behind bars.
* Support law enforcement at all levels.
* Ensure the integrity of every election.
* Appoint judges and justices who uphold the Constitution and don't legislate from the bench.
* Require cooperation with federal authorities to capture criminal illegal aliens.

**Individual Liberty & American Values
**I've always believed in freedom and common sense. We must defend these values, especially for our most vulnerable. My vision includes:

* [_Protecting women's sports by ensuring men do not compete in them_](https://u29856681.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.BdhjT3EcJBP2yWXmot-2FdEL6Nyoz20vbF8BjheR8YNa3-2FzYg7ud6LFaK44alRykDsYmLnQCTT2WThuBy-2BoLPV21TkUo1vFh6TzioGjIjxjqnhqL-2Bok2lA-2BYKnO-2FTpPAkmhKlB_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVDHKEOVw9cuvROXrcAsxwuAXpTiIzdbz4tu8qtzPkPgz3Rb45xRo37axdRsvzGoo3hYChZclIse3lYd2SfSQWsxkFh4-2Bag9WGwEWQVYJkruyiV4klpBZv7J18290dA2Dc-2Bx6kvr1jLSGMTGwQY-2FiNqA5iqW9RBlm0BSZLUVQqTBmdDxqGHq-2B8Lv56ErlqRUqSUYCID419PnijiCmZaDC2J4K23KBHZfXSmuBwWLeoPiWtbI9Munn7jJQ19b32n-2BsKBACn-2Fp6PEL9tyo2QlaiQKmtA6tTU7iPdj6TyEgizRSRMbH0mem7GkktrPYwh0oLYH8FS-2BqmfBN-2FEwkBnoH85mj).
* Prohibiting sex change surgery for children.
* Requiring able-bodied adults to work to receive government assistance and banning food stamps for junk food.
* Supporting our veterans who have served our country so honorably.

This is a comprehensive vision for a stronger, freer, and more prosperous Wisconsin. It's about building on our successes and tackling today's challenges with the courage of our convictions.
Thank you for your support and your commitment to moving Wisconsin forward.
Sincerely,
Scott Walker
45th Governor of Wisconsin

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/89b21b7f-010a-4e51-ab86-09526dba8b28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Amidst all the curiosities of American public life, the Trump family has long stood out, providing a rich vein of vulgarity, vanity, and intellectual incompetence.
Yet in the theater of absurdity that is their clan, Eric Trump has ascended to a throne previously unoccupied.
He is undisputed idiot king, a grotesque epitome of stupidity so profound he renders the rest of his family--already a display of moral and cognitive deformities that would confound Sigmund Freud--almost respectable by comparison.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e168b9a3-4947-47c3-b888-62133f4e124b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Take Eric Trump's latest pronouncement.
In a Fox News interview after Charlie Kirk's death, Eric (Donald and Ivana's second son and third child) said that [bullets aimed at political figures "only go one way](https://substack.com/redirect/e9caabfe-e5e8-4275-bfc5-bde77a6f2ee2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/765c5054-492b-4f26-974a-6cdc002250c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This is not merely an error; it is the intellectual equivalent of spraying manure in your own eyes while insisting it is perfume.
In this single sentence, Eric demonstrated the mental agility of a cornered sloth. And the selective memory of a dung beetle rolling it's own feculent ball across the lawn of public discourse.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/172eba34-321d-4774-b46d-dd3172fb4509?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Eric cited attacks on his father, on Brett Kavanaugh years ago, and on Steve Scalise years before that. But, he magically forgot the myriad attacks on democrats.
This year, [the victims of political/ideological shootings](https://substack.com/redirect/e9152133-5de3-442a-9ab9-c0c7de63f281?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and others violence have sadly been many.
They have included a leading Democratic lawmaker shot and killed and her colleague injured in Minnesota, and the attempted murder of Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro. He and his family survived an arson attack on his home while they slept inside.
Also, a policeman was murdered while protecting the CDC from an armed madman who harbored [MAGA-made vaccine conspiracy](https://substack.com/redirect/974212da-0464-4efe-b255-9edb7013887f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) theories, and [several school children gunned down in mass shootings](https://substack.com/redirect/5be131fa-7bfa-47b4-9560-e7d135620545?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) carried out by professed right-wing lunatics.
But according to Eric Trump, only liberals engage in violence and only conservatives are targeted.
To place Eric in the family hierarchy of idiocy is to witness a masterclass in comparative incompetence.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.JbIJKTfHKVXJiKjXQMe6iQYupz2gMhTEk5ngKZLaJHA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=173606271)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a0b762b8-fd52-443c-965a-44197d3d9510?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Eric's older brother Donald Jr, with all his graceless cunning and [rapid fire hyperbolic hate](https://substack.com/redirect/1916a451-d34b-4bee-84af-a794732e3e15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), is at least capable of formulating business plans that occasionally bear fruit.
Don Jr. is like a rabid fox sneaking through the henhouse.
Ivanka, airbrushed and polished, possesses the superficial charm of a Siamese cat preening under a diamond chandelier. Even Trump Sr.--for all his crimes, dementia, narcissism, and endless lies--can, on rare occasions, stumble upon a logical statement.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/aeb93635-7032-40e9-b2a8-aa6a4f63cfff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Eric, by contrast, is a disheveled and hungry hyena gnawing on the bones of reality.
He is a creature so hollow that one suspects the only thing inside his skull is a small, echoing chamber where ignorance laughs at itself.
Eric's historical blunders read like a horrifying catalog of imbecility.
During the 2020 election, he demonstrated practically no understanding of vote counting. In the Trump organization's 2023 New York civil fraud trial, Eric flailed helplessly under questioning on the witness stand.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6cc6d1de-72c8-4270-bfd5-fdc76f3d128a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Even a chimpanzee, if trained, could have offered more cogent testimony.
Earlier this year, in a 2025 Financial Times interview, Eric Trump spoke of entering politics and said this path "would be an easy one."
Second grade reasoning is Eric's sweet spot. And he counts on everybody else being just as obtuse.
A few weeks ago, Eric Trump [denied that his father could have drawn a bawdy sketch for Jeffrey Epstein's 50th birthday](https://substack.com/redirect/d731ad1f-637f-449c-b0a9-939f53477ee6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). "My father doesn't draw cartoons," said Eric. Like clockwork, several Trump drawn sketches quickly emerged from charity auctions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/644ae1a1-37d6-4748-ac79-bdaeffb63028?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.JbIJKTfHKVXJiKjXQMe6iQYupz2gMhTEk5ngKZLaJHA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=173606271)
Don Jr. hatches schemes like a feral dog cornered in a junkyard. Ivanka glides through photo ops like a delicate swan on a mud puddle.
Eric bumbles through public life like a blissfully unaware manure-smeared piglet in a cathedral. If there were ever a poster child for mental vacancy, it is Eric Trump.
He seems perpetually on the verge of discovering fire and promptly placing his hand in it. He behaves like he was hatched in some poorly ventilated incubator for dimwits.
He is the sort of creature who blunders through life, knocking things over, only to assume such clumsiness [is his rightful place of authority](https://substack.com/redirect/ee8dd63b-f9f2-4a54-b697-9de3a84845d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Relatedly, there is Eric Trump's performative morality. Recently, Eric pledged to donate proceeds from his memoir to Turning Point USA, in the wake of Charlie Kirk's assassination.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c976aa95-dcf8-4e62-b33b-ecd6ba9eb139?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Yes, Eric leveraged the killing to promote his book. And Eric was baffled when critics said the pledge looked opportunistic. Maybe the word itself baffled Eric since "opportunistic" has five syllables.
Eric Trump is, in short, a living [monument to human stupidity](https://substack.com/redirect/a1de79a6-08ec-4d35-9f8e-5c2120786834?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
He is the family's apex of ignorance. The pinnacle of self-important incompetence. The organism whose very existence makes the rest of the Trump clan's failings appear almost tolerable.
Nearly every word Eric utters reflects intellectual constipation of the highest order.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/09f37f99-be6f-4ddc-aecd-f349e078ba90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If there were an Olympics of idiocy, Eric would not merely win the gold; he would paint the entire podium with fertilizer, swallow it, and parade it through the streets.
All while insisting the world admire his brilliance.
In Eric Trump, our nation should observe a cautionary tale.
When arrogance, self-delusion, and nonsense coalesce in a single human form, the result is a creature so repulsive that even the most absurd myths of antiquity pale in comparison.
If anybody seeks a personification of incompetence, a carnival of brainlessness, a grotesque spectacle of mental vacancy--look no further. Eric Trump is that being.
He is, quite simply, the stupidest Trump. And that may be his greatest achievement.

In the Trump organization's 2023 New York civil fraud trial, Eric flailed helplessly under questioning on the witness stand. | | ---|---|--- Even a chimpanzee, if trained, could have offered more cogent testimony. Earlier this year, in a 2025 Financial Times interview, Eric Trump spoke of entering politics and said this path "would be an easy one." Second grade reasoning is Eric's sweet spot. And he counts on everybody else being just as obtuse. A few weeks ago, Eric Trump . "My father doesn't draw cartoons," said Eric. Like clockwork, several Trump drawn sketches quickly emerged from charity auctions. | | ---|---|--- Don Jr. hatches schemes like a feral dog cornered in a junkyard. Ivanka glides through photo ops like a delicate swan on a mud puddle. Eric bumbles through public life like a blissfully unaware manure-smeared piglet in a cathedral. If there were ever a poster child for mental vacancy, it is Eric Trump. He seems perpetually on the verge of discovering fire and promptly placing his hand in it. He behaves like he was hatched in some poorly ventilated incubator for dimwits. He is the sort of creature who blunders through life, knocking things over, only to assume such clumsiness . Relatedly, there is Eric Trump's performative morality. Recently, Eric pledged to donate proceeds from his memoir to Turning Point USA, in the wake of Charlie Kirk's assassination. | | ---|---|--- Yes, Eric leveraged the killing to promote his book. And Eric was baffled when critics said the pledge looked opportunistic. Maybe the word itself baffled Eric since "opportunistic" has five syllables. Eric Trump is, in short, a living . He is the family's apex of ignorance. The pinnacle of self-important incompetence. The organism whose very existence makes the rest of the Trump clan's failings appear almost tolerable. Nearly every word Eric utters reflects intellectual constipation of the highest order. | | ---|---|--- If there were an Olympics of idiocy, Eric would not merely win the gold; he would paint the entire podium with fertilizer, swallow it, and parade it through the streets. All while insisting the world admire his brilliance. In Eric Trump, our nation should observe a cautionary tale. When arrogance, self-delusion, and nonsense coalesce in a single human form, the result is a creature so repulsive that even the most absurd myths of antiquity pale in comparison. If anybody seeks a personification of incompetence, a carnival of brainlessness, a grotesque spectacle of mental vacancy--look no further. Eric Trump is that being. [](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
[](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
__“We must confront crime head-on and restore safety for all Americans: no more excuses, no more weak-kneed policies in Democrat-run cities.” – DJT__ ____
And I didn’t stop there.

I made it crystal clear that action is coming to **DEMOCRAT-RUN CITIES** where crime and chaos are RAMPANT:
__“We’re going in: whether the Radical Left likes it or not. If Democrat politicians won’t protect their citizens, I WILL. We will send in the National Guard, we will end the bloodshed, and we will RESTORE LAW AND ORDER.” – DJT__

That’s the truth, and they’re PANICKING!
Instead of cheering for safer streets and cities, they’re plotting my REMOVAL from office and the **OBLITERATION** of the MAGA movement.
The Radical Left wants one thing, and one thing only: **TO IMPEACH ME AND REMOVE ME FROM OFFICE LIKE A DOG!**

[EMERGENCY PETITION](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
__They want me DECLARED UNFIT for making America safe again. I am working DAY AND NIGHT to Save America!__
THEY HATE ME and MAGA because I kept my promises to you. They also HATE Patriots like YOU for LOVING our country and being PROUD TO BE AN AMERICAN!
The ****RADICAL LEFT**** has rallied **ONE MILLION RADICAL LEFT LUNATICS** to sign their petition to remove me from office.
That’s why I’m launching my OWN EMERGENCY PETITION, and asking **2 MILLION** proud MAGA Patriots who stand with me to add their names ASAP.

[SIGN EMERGENCY PETITION](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
We must show the Radical Left that MAGA Patriots will NEVER be bullied, silenced, or outnumbered. MAGA IS UNBREAKABLE!
Let’s send a message so LOUD, so STRONG, and so POWERFUL that the Radical Left will NEVER forget what happens when you go after ME and when they go after YOU: the American People.
**Together, we will show them the POWER of the greatest movement in history.**
We will not bend. We will not break. And we will NEVER SURRENDER!

[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
May God Bless you,

[](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
Donald J. Trump

body:

| | ,

**I love my neighbor. Democrat or Republican, black or white, rich or poor— _because we are all Americans, and we are all created in the image of God._**

But loving our neighbor doesn’t mean surrendering our values. In fact, it’s the opposite. Because when we fight for freedom, faith, family, and conservative values—we fight not just for ourselves, but for every American.

**That’s why I’m asking you to take a stand with me. Today, I’m launching** _[_the Love Your Neighbor Pledge_](https://alexforarizona.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67160ca84dc611797a3361cec&id=0e84b42613&e=36b5d8efc6)_**—a vow to honor every American while never backing down in the fight for liberty.**

[__Will you sign your name right now and join me in this pledge?__](https://alexforarizona.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67160ca84dc611797a3361cec&id=0057dfd281&e=36b5d8efc6)

The man charged, Decarlos Brown Jr., had **14 arrests** for violent crimes, including assault and armed robbery, yet he was walking free. Why? _**Because former Governor Roy Cooper’s soft-on-crime policies let dangerous criminals like Brown back onto our streets.**_

Roy Cooper’s 2020 executive order, pushing lenient pretrial release policies, kept criminals like Brown out of jail, endangering lives like Iryna’s. clean_body: I’m outraged and heartbroken over the senseless murder of Iryna Zarutska, a 23-year-old Ukrainian refugee, stabbed to death on Charlotte’s light rail. | Fellow Conservative, Like you, I’m outraged and heartbroken over the senseless murder of Iryna Zarutska, a 23-year-old Ukrainian refugee, stabbed to death on Charlotte’s light rail. The man charged, Decarlos Brown Jr., had 14 arrests for violent crimes, including assault and armed robbery, yet he was walking free. Why? Because former Governor Roy Cooper’s soft-on-crime policies let dangerous criminals like Brown back onto our streets. Roy Cooper’s 2020 executive order, pushing lenient pretrial release policies, kept criminals like Brown out of jail, endangering lives like Iryna’s. Three months after Cooper’s order, Brown was released -- and arrested three more times between 2021 and 2025. Now, a young woman is gone, and Cooper wants to represent us in the U.S. Senate? I’m asking you to join me in demanding accountability. Roy Cooper’s dangerous policies have failed North Carolina, and we can’t let him take them to Washington. Iryna Zarutska deserved to feel safe in America. Instead, Cooper’s weak-on-crime approach let a career criminal roam free, with devastating consequences. This petition isn’t just a signature – it’s a stand for justice, for Iryna, and for every North Carolinian who deserves to live without fear. Here in Minnesota, we’ve cut child poverty, expanded labor rights, invested in education, made sure every student gets free breakfast and lunch at school, and so much more.

That’s why I’m running — because we’ve got a lot more work to do, and I’m sure as hell not going to let MAGA extremists flip this state red.
