I want to tell you about a few things that are important to me, Peter, so I hope you’ll give me just a minute or two of your time today: **Public education:** My mom was a public school teacher right here in North Carolina, and I attended public schools all the way from first grade through university and law school. Our future leaders are learning in public schools today. I believe _every_ child deserves an excellent public education — no matter where their parents live or what they earn — and I’ll make public education a priority in the Senate. **Health care access:** Expanding Medicaid was one of our most impactful accomplishments during my service as Governor of North Carolina. America is the richest country in the world, and every one of us deserves the care we need to stay healthy — and bringing Medicaid Expansion to NC helped more than 670,000 people get it. But the entire Medicaid system is now at risk because national Republicans decided to slash Medicaid funding and give a handout to the rich instead. I will fight to save Medicaid for all Americans. **Voting rights:** North Carolina has been a proving ground for the GOP’s worst efforts to undermine voting rights and access. They’ve enacted ultra-partisan gerrymanders and restrictive anti-voter laws. In the wake of a 2024 election loss, Republicans even launched a lawsuit attempting to throw out tens of thousands of valid ballots and change the result. We must defend and expand voting rights to ensure that every one of us can have our fair say in our democracy — and we have to be prepared for the GOP to try to steal future elections that they lose. **[Peter, I know we share many of the same values, beliefs and hopes for our nation’s future. I’m ready to do everything in my power to make this country better for all of us, but I need your help to make it to the U.S. Senate. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

clean_body: Billionaires are gaming the system—and Congress is letting them. | | | Friend, Billionaires are gaming the system—and Congress is letting them. The “Buy, Borrow, Die” loophole is billionaires’ golden ticket: they buy assets that soar in value, borrow against them to fund their luxury lifestyles tax-free, and then pass everything to heirs without ever paying taxes. Meanwhile, working families get taxed every paycheck, every time. This scam steals trillions from schools, healthcare, housing, and climate action—all so billionaires can live tax-free. Senator Ron Wyden tried to stop it in 2023 with the Billionaires Income Tax Act, but lobbyists crushed it. Now Wyden is expected to bring the bill back. This is our shot—and we can’t let the billionaires win again. Under Donald Trump, prices for groceries, gas, and rent are skyrocketing while billionaires laugh their way to the bank. As The Atlantic revealed, “Buy, Borrow, Die” isn’t a loophole anymore—it’s the billionaire business model. It’s unfair, it’s destructive, and working people are demanding action. With the midterm elections rapidly approaching, Congress has a choice: side with everyday Americans or keep letting billionaires rob the country blind. End the scam that erases taxable gains at death. Tax billionaires on their unrealized gains every year. Shut down the borrowing tricks that let the rich live tax-free. It’s common sense. Thanks for everything you do. Josh | | Sent via . To update your email address, change your name or address, or to stop receiving emails from Democrats.com, please .

name: James Talarico
subject: Thank you, Peter.
body:
[1]Talarico for Texas

Peter —

My spirit is full.

One week ago, we launched this campaign — and the response has been
overwhelming.

I’m amazed by what this team has accomplished in such a short amount of
time.

Last Tuesday, 1,800 people showed up in Round Rock with less than 12 hours
notice.

At that launch rally, I announced that we had raised $1 million in 12
hours. 97% of our donations are $100 or less. $0 from corporate PACs.

Since Tuesday, thousands of Texans have shown up to rallies in San
Antonio, in Fort Bend, and in Houston.

[ https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-launch.bF5RK3&refcode=em250916-ak&t=1001&akid=44%2E1347274%2EaxuHRD ]video

I’ve visited with local officials, worshiped with a Houston church, and
joined the picket line with striking hotel workers demanding better wages
and better working conditions. This is truly a campaign of, by, and for
the people.

We are building a true grassroots movement. We are going everywhere and
talking to everyone to take back Texas from billionaire mega-donors and
their puppet politicians.

It’s an incredible start, but we know it will only get tougher from here.

The attacks have started. Right-wing super PACs have pledged to spend tens
of millions of dollars to buy this seat.

But I’m a Texan and a former middle school teacher. I don’t scare easily —
especially knowing you have my back.

Thank you again. I couldn’t be prouder to be in this fight with you.

James

James is running for the U.S. Senate to take back power for working
people. We need new leadership in Washington that will take on the corrupt
status quo. James will never hesitate to speak truth to power.

[ https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-launch.bF5RK3&refcode=em250916-ak&t=1003&akid=44%2E1347274%2EaxuHRD ]Please consider making a contribution to become a Founding Donor. Our
campaign has an official FEC deadline on September 30, and small-dollar
donations from folks like you are critical.

[ https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-launch.bF5RK3&refcode=em250916-ak&t=1004&akid=44%2E1347274%2EaxuHRD ]DONATE

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.jamestalarico.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=44%2E1347274%2EaxuHRD

**High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.** **Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.** At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts. **By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch.** She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground.Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina. Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks. **She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.** Nancy is fighting to:
* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast
* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency
* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free
* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate
* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think
* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front. **South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.**

Peter,

Today is National Voter Registration Day, **and your voice has never been more important.**

At its core, democracy is simple: When people are able to vote, their voices shape our future. Every ballot cast is a chance for neighbors, families, and communities to be heard. That’s how democracy is supposed to work— _when everyone has the chance to make their voice count._

But right now, that promise is being chipped away by an administration hellbent on rigging the system in their favor.

Instead of empowering voters, the GOP is doing everything it can to make it harder for people to participate. They’re redrawing congressional maps to water down Democratic votes and trying to end mail-in voting so seniors, working families, and folks in rural areas can’t easily cast a ballot. **➤➤ BREAKING: GOP pushes “Super SAVE Act”, a turbocharged voter suppression bill** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115350600/570019106/55160957?refcode=em-9.16.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOGUwYmFiMC00YzkzLWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WzdRMXYM4xdvVpvIry4ZJiXYltZ9zJU3ATxoH3BgeWc=)**
* * *
Friend. Right‐wing activist Cleta Mitchell is pushing for a “Super SAVE Act”, **a far more extreme version of the SAVE Act** that would impose devastating restrictions on who can register to vote. While many rushed to put out something regarding the political terrorist act that took the life of Charlie Kirk, I felt it was important to turn internally and reflect. Sometimes it's not the first story that matters and I have taken one from the Israelis - want the real story wait 2 days.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..ZcPSUSy8SvM1w_45LLVZHqAzgqBcrXvXtw97YQtzoQI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=173802346)
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=173802346&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTczODAyMzQ2LCJpYXQiOjE3NTgwNjI2MjgsImV4cCI6MTc2MDY1NDYyOCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.5nYjoOa3rhUzgm8AjzaO7AQoEI5P_BzipsgHzjqTjw4)
Charlie Kirk's untimely assassination evoked memories in my family of the assassination of JFK and the question of: **Where were you on November 22, 1963?** Despite a lack of social media, every patriotic American knew where they were that day.
**In more recent times, it was: Where were you on September 11, 2001?**
**24 years later it is: Where were you on September 10, 2025?**
For me, I was in Washington DC with several leaders of the Druze Community. They were addressing a powerful group of Christian leaders so they could bring a message back to their community and their government offices that they represent that there was a September 11th genocide in Syria to the Druze people and other religious and ethnic minorities by the same Al-Qaeda forces that attacked America and threatened our democracy.
The message was that 18 percent of the Suwayda province of Syria is Christian and they suffer the same fate as the Druze. I was sitting in my chair when a dear friend, who was just on his way out came back into this house and whispered Charlie was shot. This man was a dear friend of Charlie; he then departed with tears in his eyes.
From that moment, I watched the wave of the audience from their own social media feeds as they received that message. It was reminiscent of watching fear travel during multiple running of the bulls events I did in Pamplona for my 21st birthday present which was not to die.
It was fitting as a man of Jewish faith to be in a room of Christians when that news was received and I am grateful that I had a community around me that I could be present for to comfort and to be comforted. We ended that meeting in prayer for the genocide in Syria and for Charlie Kirk and his family.
As I have followed Charlie Kirk over the years, I have witnessed a man who had strong Christian faith wake up a nation to political engagement. He was a driving force behind President Trump's re-election. Charlie's Turning Point gave conservatives and those curious about conservative ideas a platform and a place to learn on the most hostile American territory - **Higher Education.**
The timing of Charlie's death on the eve of September 11th was no coincidence. It is fitting that his group is called Turning Point. Charlie's murder is a turning point for so many reasons.
For those in recovery or families around recovery, there is a passage in Chapter 5 - How it Works: _Remember that we deal with alcohol - cunning, baffling, powerful! Without help it is too much for us. But there is One who has all power - that One is God. May you find him now. Half measures availed us nothing. We stood at the turning point. We asked His protection and care with complete abandon._
Charlie Kirk's platform offered a place where ideas of different political, personal and spiritual ideologies could be expressed in an open forum (from his perspective) while being typically trolled from his counter-perspective.
**The Birth of Political Cancel Culture:**
Political rhetoric and cancel culture began circa 2014 and went full throttle on November 8 and the early morning of November 9, 2016 with the victory of Donald J Trump over Hillary Clinton (the first endorsed female president candidate). It was this victory and loss by Hillary that America lost the ability to have civilized conversations about differing political, social and religious viewpoints with a modicum of decorum.
Growing up, I was taught that many Republicans and Democrats in the halls of Congress were friends. This was due to a political debate process where both sides took the time to know their arguments and their opponent's counter arguments. This intellectual approach to issues allowed for debate and mutual respect and the achievement of progress for our nation.
This was also true of Supreme Court justices with the example of Ruth Bader Ginsburg and Antonin Scalia.
When the day was done, many of these politicians, regardless of party lines, grabbed a drink together. _**Our Congress had a camaraderie that surpassed political ideology as these Congressmen and Congresswomen served the people first and not just their party and realized that they needed each other to pass legislation.**_
**America 's Turning Point - November 9, 2016**
The Turning Point for America was the early morning of November 9, 2016 when a sea of Hillary Clinton supporters waited for an address from Hillary at the Center and she left them hanging. _**They were never all gathered again in the same room as these political volunteers and paid supporters left that early morning and Hillary never conceded or gave a speech.**_ These loyal supporters were mostly young voters and females. They were crying.
_**There was no mechanism and no forum for these supporters to go through the 5 stages of political grief.**_ There was no closure and no guidance from Hillary and her campaign. She abandoned ship and this abandonment also caused more long-term issues. They left that building rudderless and no outlet to channel their feelings.
As someone who was in New York City with my conservative views, there were places I could not go as the negativity towards President Trump's victory fueled the era of hatred of the radical left against the radical right ideologies. In New York City and many other Urban areas, the belief was we had the first African-American President with Obama and Hillary was the guaranteed first Female President based on her political accomplishments to date and her gender. _**It was the Age of Entitlement ushered in on the Hillary campaign that blossomed into an Era of protests that caused death and destruction.**_
**The Importance of Charlie Kirk and Turning Point**
Charlie Kirk fought so hard to expose and inform the electorate. We must not forget the George Floyd movement, Antifa, the takeover of Seattle, BLM, Free Palestine and on and on and on and the vitriol that followed. The Liberal hatred became the message. This must be contrasted with Trump's failed Assassination attempt and the support that broke out. No cities were looted.
**The Charlie Kirk Effect**
In the days following Charlie's untimely death, we have witnessed miracles of peaceful vigils and popular icons (that we would have never expected) sharing love and support for Charlie Kirk. These Americans and supporters of Charlie Kirk worldwide channeled their efforts to create forums for those in mourning to comfort and be comforted. This is the foundation that Americans are unifying in their faith to build upon. _**His death and the 24th anniversary of 9-11-01 were a tragic reminder that Never Forget 9-11 has to be remembered again with present day terrors for us to be woken up to what is really going on.**_
Charlie Kirk's life was a profound journey that was political and driven by faith and in the past few years, Charlie's focus was Faith first. He led by attraction and not promotion of his Christian faith and more youth moved to God.
Last Sunday, youth flocked to church. This is a beautiful movement, now being called the Charlie Kirk effect. Men purchased suits and expressed appreciation for being woken up to Faith.
Faith is desperately needed today where America, a nation built on faith has lost its way. A lack of faith allows fear to enter in and dominate the political landscape. There are also a lot of Christians and Jews in Name Only that do not practice religion.
As we remember Charlie Kirk, we focus on his legacy to open dialogue against differing viewpoints, the deep love for God, Family and Country and his unfinished work to unite this nation through faith.
_**The MAGA Moment of Make America Godly Again is Upon us because of you Charlie Kirk.**_

The Trump administration may have SCOTUS on speed dial, but the lower courts are standing up for us. | |
---
Peter, **We the People aren’t the only ones angry about the Supreme Court’s actions.** Lower court judges are standing up for democracy in case after case—trying to stop Trump from wantonly deporting immigrants, stealing our money, firing federal workers, and more. **These aren’t just Obama, Clinton, and Biden appointees. Many of them were appointed by George W. Bush and even Ronald Reagan.** That’s because standing up against Trump’s attacks on democracy isn’t partisan—it’s about the Constitution of the United States. Each and every lower court judge took an oath to defend it, and many of them are committed to honoring that vow. [**Lower court judges are facing dangerous attacks on their character and patriotism from the MAGA apparatus and from Trump himself. Add your name to thank them for their bravery, and to tell them that you stand with them as they defend our rights and our democracy.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-k_iNETHG_dSU5N-9e0tydUoWi4Rv8gEu6W4TmY7XjxS2LkvWDBgyckEXDaeT5wDZPN9IzzHN-SpwyjhTq9eKEnA20MoUpTeLyBZ8DYfUovrSuXehNHXZuPDWbLjOh6ZyDSEP1tuW3WCY6jHmw755ktB09kG2R4a8H0o4zzIMNZ3OS58bHjN1Zk4pqtANDFkCfcSJmIqZX1-FNdBBLJ_ZfuISHyUrpEyZFKQtlVJeI50zS-8Q3cU4kq2om8jR6cuNuh0OiJUzVT92g93eteMRloVSSOgbXVwf-owvtlWzxaq8EG9X9mc-HyIkQ9HsSfQ9oTkvHyGiRxQVpA-x_G1Bq/4jy/fNeggMxVRcuDzcheIkyubA/h0/h001.iq_IUQG5FFc2_jHmyAmfdD7mTzzfHAP_4OKYDFRIkMM) [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-k_iNETHG_dSU5N-9e0tydUoWi4Rv8gEu6W4TmY7XjxS2LkvWDBgyckEXDaeT5wDZPN9IzzHN-SpwyjhTq9eKEnA20MoUpTeLyBZ8DYfUovt_Es-6DgxqxE4jQT11xRVipXaHPNYQpGtx-NPWrpGXqrBEdDJIie_rHOarIql9orE2vnIyyMLaMH3eIVfY6c_0h7gDczYY7Jy_NW1upFL-LQOfMNwTNb5B9cMojM4vGQnoTm3NDvUX9zpVSH4JZtbemCV7DoyhnUBp0VfBZZp7ASFRHdPue2oHSniPDUdlqCVLKKdU1twsTT4-XiJqzDQdSdA3k5C1uhbVCqhDfRTNb/4jy/fNeggMxVRcuDzcheIkyubA/h1/h001.42ASFNbByeJphbQpipXXcgV6msCQnTD-hVnmFvOnz8g) **Just last week, a lower court judge blocked Trump from removing Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook from her role.** Trump has been dead-set on firing her in order to gain even more control over our economy. name: AOC
subject: When millions of us do tiny things, we can disrupt these systems.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Please do not fall for the illusion or the lie that any action is too small. **There is no action too small**.
In fact, when millions of us _do_ tiny things, we _can_ disrupt these systems. I'm not saying that getting in the game is going 100% to change the outcome, but it may, because **we are in an unprecedented time**.
The unprecedented time can mean, of course, many bad things happen — but it can also mean that **unpredictable things can happen, and can even go our way**.
I was elected in the first Trump administration and nobody ever, _ever_ thought that I had a prayer in order to win. I was a waitress. I was challenging the head of a political machine who was supposed to be the next Speaker of the House.
They spent $3 million against me while I was wiping down tables, and we won. Why?
**Because an unpredictable window has opened**.
Do not comply in advance. You try anyway.
We will not be afraid – **because that’s what they want**.
But our movement for real progress will have to push harder than ever these next four years.
Help us continue the fight with a grassroots contribution today.
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20250916?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/34794?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=em20250916-9764-&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9764%2E2526796%2EysJZbO)
In solidarity,
Alexandria

# Charlie Kirk -- Champion of Free Speech & Civil Discourse
Being American means having the freedom to speak, debate, and engage in civil discourse. Charlie Kirk did that.

Charlie’s tragic murder while speaking with students is a wake-up call for all of us.

I lived through the Cultural Revolution. I experienced and understand how political rhetoric inspired violence to be carried out by Mao’s Red Guards, mostly young students, which ultimately led to the deaths of 20 million people.

Mao's propaganda was emotional and was used to brainwash youth to turn them against Mao's political enemies so he could regain political power. His tactic was to create divisions and hatred between the so-called oppressed against their oppressors, mostly people just next door.

We must stop the radicalization of our youth by biased grievance studies, divisive media, and by politicians demonizing those they disagree with.

It is time to bring us back together.

**E pluribus unum!**

May God bless Charlie’s family and USA!

| | **Political Leaders Using Tragedy for Power**
New Mexico's Speaker of the House Javier Martinez posted an example of the kind of tone deaf rhetoric that can lead to violence. This man — the SECOND most powerful person in our state — called himself a "victim" while holding massive legislative power.
**Key points:**
* Martinez used inflammatory language like "fascist clowns" and "bring it" during a national tragedy

* He's one of the most powerful people in New Mexico but plays victim on social media

* Meanwhile, New Mexican families suffer under last-in-education, first-in-crime policies

* His son will get the best opportunities while poor families get his political theater

**Impact:** When leaders with real power waste time on victim screeds instead of solving problems, everyone loses.

| |
💰 **MAYOR'S TAXPAYER-FUNDED CAMPAIGN SCHEME**
Albuquerque Mayor Tim Keller just got caught using your tax dollars to fund his re-election campaign. He's paying TV stations $20,000-$40,000 to run his "State of the City" address five times right before the election. Previous years? He gave these speeches in March, May, June, or August — never during election season.
📺 **SHOCKING COLLAPSE OF LOCAL TV IS WORSE THAN YOU THINK**
We did a deep dive into local TV ratings and the numbers are devastating. KOAT lost 49% of morning viewers. KRQE lost 77% of morning viewers. KOB lost 31% of morning viewers. These stations are bleeding audience and desperate for any revenue — even if it means becoming campaign arms during election season.
🚨 **UNIVERSAL CHILDCARE SCAM**
Governor Lujan Grisham announced "free" universal childcare for ALL families — even millionaires. Translation: Poor families will subsidize rich families' childcare through their tax dollars. We break down why eliminating income tax for families under $100K would actually help people build wealth.

From brewpub owner to Mayor of Denver to Governor of Colorado, my entire career has been about bringing people together and finding ways to actually help Coloradans.
But Donald Trump and National Republicans aren’t trying to work together. They’re trying to ram through their agenda – and it’s hurting too many people.
Right now, prices are increasing and families are struggling to get by. Instead of helping lower prices, Republicans passed their so-called “Big Beautiful Bill” that rips away health care from tens of thousands of Coloradans and forces premiums to skyrocket — all to give new tax breaks to the ultrawealthy.
When I was Governor, I expanded Medicaid to cover 400,000 more Coloradans. That’s what the Republicans are now taking away. I won’t agree to that. Ever.
Plus, Trump’s illegal tariffs are taxing working families thousands of dollars every year and making it near impossible for small businesses to survive. The courts have ruled that it is Congress’ authority to impose tariffs and these tariff-taxes are illegal. We need to stand up and take that power back from Trump.
If Republicans want to avoid a shutdown, they should restore the health care and nursing home care funding and support for rural hospitals that they voted to rip away, and take action to end the tariffs.
**If they won’t negotiate, I’ll vote against their government funding plan.**
This is not a moment that any of us can be silent. We need to make our voices heard loud and clear. **[So if you’re with me – if you agree we need to put Colorado’s families above billionaires and partisan politics – sign your name next to mine today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/115352890/570026644/495742200?refcode=email_091625_budget&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NTE0NmE5MC01ODkzLWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h5rmQXrugA2LoTU_FsfpzzyAYCdTpTkkHrAPAHk-xBw=&emci=ab047bb8-4793-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=75146a90-5893-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=7280715)**
